envelope.response:
**Findings so far**

Our first attempt combined three-month momentum in average hours and in hourly pay as a rank product. It failed. Its next-month predictive correlation was slightly negative, insignificant and unchanged across common-index regimes.

The second attempt favored groups whose V02 flow rate rose faster than V03 over three months. It produced a meaningfully negative correlation, with a t-statistic near minus two, concentrated when the common index was low. Reversing its direction, perhaps conditioned on the low regime, looks promising.

Both features showed low overlap with base signals and moderate rank persistence.
